```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-pinned-setup-zig:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify mlugg/setup-zig is pinned
        run: |
          echo "Searching for unpinned mlugg/setup-zig usage..."
          if grep -R "mlugg/setup-zig@v2" .github/workflows/*.yml | grep -v "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" > /dev/null; then
            echo "Found unpinned mlugg/setup-zig usage. Please pin to the SHA."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "All mlugg/setup-zig usages are pinned."
          fi
```
